history.summary: Initial web/mobile prototype, device catalog, communication types and ports; early iPhone local-file execution failed.
Standalone HTML prototype published to RoomDesigner repository; README and GitHub Pages deployment steps.
history.runtime_status: user reported initial UI worked only after hosting

history.summary: Mobile group picker, double-tap properties, four-side port placement using select, drag-to-nearest-port wiring; syntax fix commit 32ddefae.
No independently verified V6 release in this chat. Do not fabricate release evidence.
User selector, Save/Save As, local drawings list, embedded revision snapshots and change summaries.
Two entry choices New/Existing User, rename user, direction radio buttons; SVG upload field partial only.

history.summary: Add independent Project Evolution ledger alongside application and companion guide, preserve decisions, gaps and review history.

Each placed device already has editable name; cable gets explicit editable name. Duplicate selected device with fresh device/port identifiers or duplicate cable with fresh cable identifier; device duplication does not copy cables. UI button inside Properties.
Direct/broken choice, touch waypoints, live multi-segment preview, persistence in cable.waypoints, termination only at device port.
Fix mobile cable port hit-testing via SVG screen coordinate transforms, 60px magnetic snap, eliminate duplicate waypoint event registration.
Persistent visible broken cable during multi-tap entry, stable solid bends and active dashed segment; draft remains across finger release.
Two-finger pinch zoom around midpoint plus midpoint panning. Suspend single-finger manipulation while multi-touch active.
Always-visible live zoom percentage badge, including pinch updates.
Pan canvas in Select mode by dragging blank area with one finger; pan deltas corrected via SVG screen scale; device dragging and two-finger pinch remain available.
Add 14px pinch activation threshold to avoid unintended zoom while translating with two fingers.
Double tap empty canvas to zoom 1.25x around tap midpoint, separate from device double tap.
Double-tap blank canvas multiplier 1.25x → 1.5x.
Copy/Delete moved to top of device and cable property sheets, Save remains at bottom.
SVG nested port event classification fixed; empty canvas double-tap moved to tap-release gesture rather than pointer down; moving canvas cannot trigger zoom gesture.
Geometry-based device hit-testing, stable zoom-aware device movement. Regression reported against V23 but default branch confirmed V21.
Click zoom percentage badge to reset to 100%, and reset viewport automatically when creating a new drawing.
Clear stale touch tracking at duplicate and primary touch; clean on capture loss/blur; enforce pointer identity for drag. Repeated failure after V23 recorded, runtime fix awaiting testing.
Fix incorrect device id/pointer id comparison blocking all object drags in V24.
Defer cable tap until release; cancel during two-finger pinch.
New drawing resets to Select, clears cable drawing and pointer states, resets zoom to 100%.
Top-row Save/Copy/Delete + lock toggle; device drag locking, real-time draft cable colors, 18px screen-space micro-bend rejection.
Three modes: direct, free-angle broken, orthogonal right-angle broken. Correct preview, persistence and movement rendering.
Remove tiny end stubs in L-shaped routing, merge collinear segments and suppress short live-preview artifacts.
Device artwork from safe SVG, English default catalog labels, and defensive iOS native-zoom prevention.
Cable hit-test and double-tap properties; adjustable line thickness/style; cable duplication with distinct parallel route for direct cables.
30 CSS pixel perpendicular snap tolerance retains a straight ongoing cable when tapping again after releasing.
Cable connection type read-only; add basic line-wall segments through Add menu; clarify pan terminology.
Wall drawing entry moved from top-level Add menu to Architecture category.
Enforce source-port side for orthogonal cable exit in preview, saved and live rendered paths.
Architecture group adds line, polyline, rectangle, square, WC, TV and Bed. Symbols remain editable vector devices.
Redo and history controls placed beside Undo in top toolbar; history sheet exposes available steps.
Normalize overshooting orthogonal cable vertices and remove zero-length/collinear spur geometry.
Pointer-down begins shape, pointer-move shows preview, pointer-up commits. Preserve chained polyline as a tap-based tool. Cancel drawing on pinch.
Proportional size buttons, rotation buttons and angle input for no-port vector objects, with rotation-aware selection.
Enforce equal square sides both preview and saved drawing while rectangle keeps independent dimensions.
Add top-layer swing door, visual wall opening, and nearest-wall position/rotation snapping without mutating walls.
Architectural connected polyline now previews provisional segment during drag and commits segments on release.
Scale selected architectural objects with two-finger pinch; keep pinch-to-zoom for canvas; remove redundant Pan footer button.
Relax proximity requirement and offer explicit selected object Resize mode for small symbols.

records.source: User repeated iPhone Safari regression report after RoomDesigner V23
records.user_statement: در زوم و پس از کپی تجهیز، با کشیدن آن زوم ناخواسته رخ می‌دهد و سایر تجهیزات غیرقابل انتخاب می‌شوند؛ اصلاح قبلی V23 مشکل را رفع نکرد.
records.assistant_interpretation: Treat unexpected pinch zoom and blocked selection as potentially stale pointer/touch state: clear tracked fingers/pinch/drag at copy completion and at new primary touch, window blur and visibility loss; only active pointer may move a selected device; remove cached pointer when capture is lost. Preserve viewport and selected duplicate.
regression_scenarios: zoom to 200 percent, copy, then drag duplicate; zoom remains fixed
select original and other devices after copy
exit and return to canvas, touch events remain usable

records.user_statement: تجهیزات انتخاب می‌شوند، اما بعد از اصلاح قبلی هیچ تجهیزی روی صفحه جابه‌جا نمی‌شود.
records.assistant_interpretation: Confirmed V24 regression: pointerMove compares drag.id (device string ID) with e.pointerId (numeric pointer ID), causing all device-drag movement events to return. Introduce separate drag.pointerId, compare pointer IDs only; preserve drag.id exclusively for device lookup.

analyses.title: Rendering strategy
analyses.assessment: Use a reusable semantic document model independent of rendering package. Evaluate JointJS Community and Konva.js against connection, routing, render, React embeddability and license before changing core architecture.

analyses.title: Interface taxonomy
analyses.assessment: Separate communication type, connector type, physical cable type, and device port. Port has stable identity, display color, placement side and attachment capacity. RS-485 is an interface, not a connector.

analyses.title: Documents and history
analyses.assessment: Each portable document holds current drawing and all revision snapshots in JSON. Names are not identity, documentId is stable. Restore must append new revision. Local Browser Storage is not shared server storage.

analyses.title: Offline vs shared persistence
analyses.assessment: GitHub Pages serves read-only static app; direct file writes require server API on IIS. Do not add this backend until migration is requested. Admin-only deletion must be implemented server-side.

analyses.title: Vector symbols security
analyses.assessment: SVG only; sanitize against scripts, event handlers, external references, foreignObject and risky URLs. Bitmap wrapping is not vectorization. True raster-to-vector is future feature and must be assessed for reliability.

analyses.title: Mobile touch fidelity
analyses.assessment: Two-stage category/device picker, double tap for Properties, dragging object, drag-to-connect with snap near ports, PWA/mobile Safari tests. Test on iPhone; syntax validation does not establish gesture correctness.

analyses.title: GitHub Pages cache/version
analyses.assessment: User saw stale v0.4 after deployments; cache-busting URL and UI version must be updated with each code release. GitHub Pages build/deploy latency remains.

verification_evidence.result: User reports updated UI visible after refresh
